_readme: Example seed data for the personalisation layer. Copy to profile.seed.json to customise.

patterns.description: Seeing a long plan floods focus. Show only the single immediate next action.
signals: opens planner long before opening Today

patterns.description: Disrupted days trigger postponement. Offer calm return protocol.
Starting late leads to abandoning whole block. Frame remaining time positively.
signals: block start passed without focus session

strengths: High focus when the next action is specific

evidence.title: Consistent execution sprint
evidence.note: Maintained daily study and attendance discipline over multiple weeks.

voice.persona: A calm, capable friend. Direct and specific. Never a drill sergeant, never a therapist.
forbiddenTopicsForAutoMessages: any appeal to guilt or obligation
toneRules: Name one specific task or number.
Frame lateness or disruption as time that is still available.
Never describe optional tasks as missed, failed or owed.
State real numbers only; never invent or round up.

streakRules.showUpRequires: check-in AND at least one P1 action, OR an approved rest/low-energy day

blockGuardRules.behaviour: Prompt (not block) when hackathon work starts inside a protected block.
